## Perf regression guards for the 43s TypeScript scan bug: behavioural tests pin… — 2026-07-25 (parent 0b6fd944e00f)

Four independent changes land in this commit.

Two regression-guard tests are added to `test_ts_resolve`: `test_config_discovery_never_descends_into_vendor_dirs` asserts that `_iter_config_files` never enters `node_modules`, `.git`, `build`, or `dist`; `test_extract_file_data_builds_one_resolver_per_source_root` spies on `TsResolver.build` and verifies exactly one construction across multiple files sharing a source root.

`plan_cmd` gains an `--offline` flag that substitutes a zero-token stub for the real `count_tokens` call, printing a notice, so the worklist is accessible without an API key or network.

`Sync` gains `retry_total_seconds` (0

### Changes

- + tests/test_ts_resolve:test_config_discovery_never_descends_into_vendor_dirs — "Assert that `_iter_config_files` never traverses `node_modules`, `.git`, `build`, or `dist` vendor/hidden directories."
- + tests/test_ts_resolve:test_extract_file_data_builds_one_resolver_per_source_root — "Assert that `TsResolver.build` is called exactly once when `extract_file_data` processes multiple files sharing a single source root."
- ~ trie/cli:plan_cmd — --offline flag: zero-token count stub instead of a real client; prints a notice.
